label_definitions.high-quality winner: Winning trade in favorable context with clean structure, confirmation, and no major weak-context flags.
label_definitions.acceptable trade: Trade that fits system rules and is not clearly ideal or clearly avoidable.
label_definitions.avoidable loser: Losing trade taken in a context that historical analysis suggests should often be skipped.
label_definitions.low-quality setup: Poor-context setup that should be downgraded or blocked regardless of outcome.

reason_code_taxonomy.late_us_trend: Trend trade taken in the late US session.
reason_code_taxonomy.post_spike: Entry immediately after an overextended bar/spike.
reason_code_taxonomy.london_drag: Trade taken in a historically weak London volatility pocket.
reason_code_taxonomy.low_vol_trend: Trend trade during low-volatility drift conditions.
reason_code_taxonomy.repeated_reentry: Repeated re-entry into the same move under degraded context.
reason_code_taxonomy.strong_trend_clean_entry: Strong trend with cleaner structure and non-spike entry.
reason_code_taxonomy.favorable_session: Session historically associated with stronger expectancy.
